# semboottools: Bootstrapping Helpers For Structural Equation Modelling

(Version 0.1.2, updated on 2026-01-25, [release
history](https://Yangzhen1999.github.io/semboottools/news/index.html))

A collection of helper functions for forming bootstrapping confidence
intervals and examining bootstrap estimates in structural equation
modelling. An introduction to the package can be found in the following
manuscript:

- Yang, W., & Cheung, S. F. (2026). Forming bootstrap confidence
  intervals and examining bootstrap distributions of standardized
  coefficients in structural equation modelling: A simplified workflow
  using the R package semboottools. *Behavior Research Methods,
  58*(2), 38. <https://doi.org/10.3758/s13428-025-02911-z>

You can learn more about this package at the [Github
page](https://Yangzhen1999.github.io/semboottools/) of this package.

An illustration of what this package can do can be found in the
following Get-Started vignette:

<https://yangzhen1999.github.io/semboottools/articles/semboottools.html>

# Installation

Stable release versions of this package can be installed from CRAN:

``` r
install.packages("semboottools")
```

The latest developmental version of this package can be installed by
`remotes::install_github`:

``` r
remotes::install_github("Yangzhen1999/semboottools")
```

# Issues

If you have any suggestions and found any bugs, please feel free to open
a GitHub issue. Thanks.

# Package index

## Main Functions

Main functions for bootstrapping.

- [`standardizedSolution_boot()`](https://Yangzhen1999.github.io/semboottools/reference/standardizedSolution_boot.md)
  : Bootstrap CIs for Standardized Solution
- [`parameterEstimates_boot()`](https://Yangzhen1999.github.io/semboottools/reference/parameterEstimates_boot.md)
  : Bootstrap CIs for Parameter Estimates
- [`store_boot()`](https://Yangzhen1999.github.io/semboottools/reference/store_boot.md)
  : Compute and Store Bootstrap Estimates
- [`print(`*`<sbt_std_boot>`*`)`](https://Yangzhen1999.github.io/semboottools/reference/print.sbt_std_boot.md)
  : Print a 'sbt_std_boot' Object
- [`print(`*`<sbt_ustd_boot>`*`)`](https://Yangzhen1999.github.io/semboottools/reference/print.sbt_ustd_boot.md)
  : Print a 'sbt_ustd_boot' Object

## Diagnostics Functions

For visualizing the distribution of the bootstrap estimates.

- [`hist_qq_boot()`](https://Yangzhen1999.github.io/semboottools/reference/hist_qq_boot.md)
  [`scatter_boot()`](https://Yangzhen1999.github.io/semboottools/reference/hist_qq_boot.md)
  : Diagnostic Plots of Bootstrap Estimates in 'lavaan'
- [`gg_hist_qq_boot()`](https://Yangzhen1999.github.io/semboottools/reference/gg_hist_qq_boot.md)
  : Diagnostic Plots of Bootstrap Estimates (ggplot2, Modular)
- [`gg_scatter_boot()`](https://Yangzhen1999.github.io/semboottools/reference/gg_scatter_boot.md)
  : Scatterplot Matrix of Bootstrap Estimates (ggplot2/GGally)
- [`jab_after_boot()`](https://Yangzhen1999.github.io/semboottools/reference/jab_after_boot.md)
  : Jackknife-after-Bootstrap (JAB) influence for lavaan bootstrap
  results
